analysis_roles.DIAGNOSTIC: checks an assumption or explains behaviour
analysis_roles.EXPLORATORY: not confirmatory; never selects a recipe and never supports a superiority claim

analysis_roles.SECONDARY: planned, reported in full, but not a headline claim

E10.detail: fixed epoch 22, no early stopping; epoch 22 is the sole primary

E8A.detail: best development epoch, patience 10, at most 100 epochs

E8B.detail: fixed epoch 22, no early stopping; epoch 22 is the sole primary

v2_01.detail: no training; a zero-shot protocol check

v2_02.detail: best development epoch (early stopping on development accuracy, best-on-development checkpointing)

CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED.allowed_claim: a descriptive statement that the configuration is better, with the capacity difference named
CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED.definition: the two sides differ in trainable capacity as well as in the factor under study
CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED.forbidden_stronger_claim: attributing the difference to the architecture or the feature alone

CLEAN_PAIRED_CONTROL.allowed_claim: a causal statement about the single factor that differs, bounded to this task, this split and these training seeds
CLEAN_PAIRED_CONTROL.definition: the two sides differ in the one factor under study and are evaluated on identical development rows
CLEAN_PAIRED_CONTROL.forbidden_stronger_claim: any generalisation beyond the tested setting, and any equivalence claim drawn from an interval that contains zero

DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.allowed_claim: a description of the measured profile
DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.definition: a described quantity, not a contrast between systems
DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.forbidden_stronger_claim: any causal reading, and any ranking against a quantity measured differently

REPRESENTATION_CONFOUNDED.allowed_claim: a system-level statement that one configuration is better under the tested conditions
REPRESENTATION_CONFOUNDED.definition: the two sides differ in representation space, embedding width or interface as well as in the factor under study
REPRESENTATION_CONFOUNDED.forbidden_stronger_claim: isolating representation quality, semantics or alignment as the cause, or calling it the sole or main bottleneck

SYSTEM_LEVEL_COMPARISON.allowed_claim: a statement about the systems as built
SYSTEM_LEVEL_COMPARISON.definition: whole systems differ in several respects at once
SYSTEM_LEVEL_COMPARISON.forbidden_stronger_claim: attributing the outcome to any single component, such as token-level access, in isolation

consumption_summary.note: a row that no specification consumes is recorded, not deleted. Several are supersession markers whose purpose is to be found and refused, and the descriptive counts exist for captions rather than for a figure of their own.

cross_family_selection_caveat: Checkpoint selection differs across families. V2, V3, E2, E3 and E8A select the best development epoch; E8B and E10 use the frozen fixed-22 rule with no early stopping. A best-on-development number and a fixed-epoch number are not selected the same way, so a side-by-side reading is a system-level comparison, not a matched one.

evidence_classes.ARM: one system's development accuracy with an evaluation interval
evidence_classes.CON: a paired contrast between two systems or conditions
evidence_classes.DSC: one descriptive scalar read from a canonical artefact
evidence_classes.SEED: one system's across-training-seed mean and sample sd
evidence_classes.SLC: one slice statistic: a question type, structure or step bucket
evidence_classes.SUP: a superseded or not-for-reporting marker, carried so a later reader can see what was ruled out and why

metric_definitions.g21_pinned_normalised_exact_match: the pinned G21 VQA-style normalised exact-match scorer used by E8A, E8B, E9 and E10.
metric_definitions.latency_and_memory_components: isolated component latencies and peak memory; valid as components only.
metric_definitions.structural_count_or_share: a counted quantity or a share of counts read from a frozen protocol artefact; not an estimate and carrying no sampling uncertainty.
metric_definitions.v2_closed_vocab_top1_index_match: argmax over the closed answer set compared with the gold label index, on the in-vocabulary development rows. The V2-era scorer.
metric_definitions.warm_median_serial_latency_ms: warm median wall-clock milliseconds for one raw image plus raw question query at batch 1, measured serially on one named node.

mixed_metric_rule: No figure axis and no table column block may place two metric_ids on a shared quantitative scale unless the specification sets mixed_metric_justification and carries the non-comparability footnote. The V2-era closed-vocabulary scorer and the pinned G21 normalised scorer are never averaged, differenced or ranked against each other.

story_stages.S00_OFF_SEQUENCE: Kept as supporting or appendix evidence, deliberately outside the main argument.
story_stages.S01_BASELINE_REPRESENTATION: Baseline and representation: what a lightweight head over frozen global CLIP features achieves from the question alone, the image alone and both.
story_stages.S02_MULTIMODAL_FUSION: Multimodal fusion: whether explicit interaction features beat plain concatenation in the low-data regime.
story_stages.S03_CAPACITY_MATCHING: Capacity matching: how much of the fusion advantage survives at an equal trainable-parameter budget.
story_stages.S04_FEATURE_ABLATION: Feature ablation: which interaction term carries the effect, and whether the two terms are redundant.
story_stages.S05_TRAINING_SCALE: Training-data scale: how the advantages move from 40k to 100k to 250k labelled questions.
story_stages.S06_TYPE_AND_DEPTH: Question type and reasoning depth: where accuracy concentrates and where the multi-step deficit sits.
story_stages.S07_VISUAL_RELIANCE: Visual reliance: how much a wrong or removed image costs each system.
story_stages.S08_LATENT_REASONER: Token-level latent reasoning: whether a question-conditioned latent-query reasoner over token features beats the global-embedding heads.
story_stages.S09_REPRESENTATION_QUALITY: Representation-quality sensitivity: what a stronger frozen dual encoder changes.
story_stages.S10_QUESTION_SIDE_SLM: Question-side SLM pretraining: whether a frozen pretrained small language model beats its random control as the question encoder.
story_stages.S11_ANSWER_SIDE_SLM_135M: Answer-side SLM pretraining at 135M: whether a frozen pretrained readout beats its random control.
story_stages.S12_ANSWER_SIDE_SLM_360M: Answer-side capacity sensitivity at 360M: whether the answer-side conclusion changes with a larger frozen language model.
story_stages.S13_COMPACT_VLM_CONTEXT: Compact-VLM context: where a frozen compact integrated VLM sits relative to these systems.
story_stages.S14_EFFICIENCY_TRADEOFF: Efficiency and accuracy: measured end-to-end serial latency against accuracy, per measurement node.
